reading.passage: On Sundays, our whole family cooks lunch together. Dad makes the soup, Mum cuts the vegetables, and I set the table. It is the happiest hour of our week.
reading.passageCn: 每个周日,我们全家一起做午饭。爸爸煮汤,妈妈切菜,我摆桌子。这是我们一周里最快乐的时光。

questions.q: Who makes the soup in the family?
How does the family feel about cooking together?
opts: It is their happiest hour of the week.

writing.prompt: Write about a happy family memory in about 60 words. Say when it happened, what you did together, and why you treasure it.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一段快乐的家庭回忆:何时发生、你们一起做了什么、为什么你珍惜它。

lines.text: Grandma's birthday is coming. What should we get her?
lines.cn: 奶奶的生日快到了,我们送她什么好呢?

lines.text: She loves tea, so let's buy her a nice tea set.
lines.cn: 她爱喝茶,我们买一套漂亮的茶具吧。

lines.text: Great idea! I'll also make her a birthday card by hand.
lines.cn: 好主意!我还要亲手给她做一张生日卡。

lines.text: She will be so happy to see the whole family together.
lines.cn: 看到全家团聚,她一定会非常开心。
